name: Marakez Real Estate Development Company K.P.S.C
summary: Real-Estate Trade Centers Company K.P.S.C. (MARAKEZ.KW) is a prominent real estate firm active in both Kuwait and the Syrian Arab Republic. Its core operations encompass the acquisition, ownership, and divestiture of various real estate assets and land plots. Furthermore, it provides comprehensive management, leasing, and marketing services for properties belonging to external clients. MARAKEZ also holds and operates a diverse portfolio of specialized properties, including resorts, hotels, health and sports facilities, private hospitals, and various tourist accommodations. This extends to commercial centers and residential communities. Beyond its direct property investments, the company delivers real estate consultation and research services. It also engages in property development and construction for both private and public sector projects, offers maintenance solutions for buildings and properties, and organizes industry events such as real estate exhibitions and auctions. Additionally, the firm has a financial arm involved in buying and selling securities and debentures. Established in 1999, the company maintains its headquarters in Kuwait City, Kuwait.
